topics: the transformer architecture and pre-training
prompting and in-context learning
retrieval-augmented generation over a document collection
fine-tuning with parameter-efficient methods (LoRA)
evaluating generated text and detecting hallucinations
agents and tool use
safety

syllabi.name: deep_learning.md
syllabi.title: Deep Learning
programs: B Tech Computer Science and Business Systems
topics: Neural networks: perceptron, multilayer networks, backpropagation, activation functions.
Optimisation: SGD, momentum, Adam, batch normalisation, dropout, weight decay.
Convolutional networks: convolution, pooling, ResNet, transfer learning.
Sequence models: RNN, LSTM, GRU, sequence-to-sequence learning.
Practical deep learning: PyTorch, GPUs, experiment tracking.

syllabi.name: introduction_to_machine_learning_open.md
syllabi.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
topics: What is machine learning; supervised and unsupervised learning; the ML workflow.
Regression: linear regression, regularisation, evaluation.
Classification: logistic regression, decision trees, k-nearest neighbours.
Clustering and dimensionality reduction: k-means, PCA.
Machine learning in engineering practice: case studies, ethics.

syllabi.name: natural_language_processing.md
syllabi.title: Natural Language Processing
topics: CO1 Pre-process and represent text (tokenisation, n-grams, TF-IDF, word embeddings).
CO2 Build sequence labelling models for part-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition.
CO3 Apply transformer encoders to classification and question answering.
Text processing: tokenisation, morphology, regular expressions, edit distance.
Language models: n-gram models, smoothing, perplexity.
Text classification: naive Bayes, logistic regression, evaluation.
Sequence labelling: HMMs, CRFs, named entity recognition.
Word embeddings and transformers: word2vec, attention, BERT fine-tuning.

syllabi.name: reinforcement_learning.md
syllabi.title: Reinforcement Learning
topics: Markov decision processes, returns, value functions, Bellman equations.
Dynamic programming, Monte Carlo and temporal-difference learning.
Function approximation, deep Q-networks.
Policy gradients, actor-critic methods, PPO.
Applications: games, robotics, recommendation.
